headline: Frequent Reworks in hugolib/page.go
diagnosis: The commit history indicates a recurring theme of fixing and reverting changes related to page type handling and rendering. The complexity of the page structure and its interactions with other components, such as templates and resources, is likely contributing to the instability.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the recent commits that involve page type handling and rendering, especially those that were reverted.
Identify specific areas in hugolib/page.go that are frequently modified, particularly around the implicit 'page' type and rendering logic.
Establish a set of clear guidelines for changes to the page structure and rendering to minimize future conflicts and reworks.
Implement a series of automated tests focused on the page rendering and type handling functionalities to catch issues early.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the core team to reduce bus factor.
